name: Gralmund the Guidestone
bio: Stoneloom's tunnel network looks erractic, but Gralmund swears there's method to the madness. Gralmund acts as the chief architect for these underground passageways, led by the light of the ancient Guidestone. The Guidestone's prismatic rays dazzle others but to Gralmund, they chart the path to Stoneloom's continued prosperity. He's yet to be proven wrong.
